Yep, really common at 20 months. Sleep often gets bumpy around now with teething, big language and motor jumps, and separation worries.

For tonight, keep the 2am visit boring. Go in, keep the lights low, say a short phrase like "night night, I'm here," and settle them in their crib or bed without picking them up or starting a play session. Doing the same thing each time teaches them that 2am is for sleeping.
